transcript:
This message comes from Schwab. At Schwab, you can get everything from self-directed investing to full-service wealth management, all in one place.
No matter your investing goal, life stage, amount to invest, or know-how, you can invest your way with Schwab.
This is NPR News Now.
The latest headlines every hour.
Live from NPR News in Washington, I'm Dave Mattingly.
Israeli elections are underway in a test of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's leadership.
NPR's Daniel Estrin reports from Tel Aviv.
Israel is holding its first national vote since the Hamas attacks of October 7, 2023, and years of war in Gaza, Lebanon, and across the region.
Those conflicts remain open. Netanyahu is running for re-election with a promise to join forces with the U.S. to launch new strikes on Iran if he is re-elected.
Most polls have shown Netanyahu and his far-right bloc trailing behind the center-right opposition led by former military chief Gadi Isinkot.
It may take weeks to find out who will be Israel's next prime minister. Voters are choosing parties running for parliament. After election day, party leaders will try to assemble a coalition.
Daniel Estrin, NPR News, Tel Aviv.
The cryptocurrency-based prediction market known as Polymarket says it's cracking down on election insider trading and market manipulation. As NPR's Luke Garrett reports, the company is investigating dozens of users for bets on the November midterm elections.
Prediction markets host millions of dollars of bets on political candidates and races.
In May, NPR reported that campaign staffers made thousands using insider polling data to turn a profit.
Polymarket's new head of investigations, Shanna Bautista, says she's built a new surveillance system to stop insider trading and market manipulation.
It's explicitly against our terms of use on both platforms, but also is against the law. So that's first and foremost. But second, if you decide that you are smarter and can do it, we will find you.
Bautista, a former FBI official, says Polymarket has launched dozens of election investigations. At least two have been referred to federal law enforcement, according to a person familiar but not authorized to share details publicly.
Luke Garrett, NPR News, Washington.
The former head of the FBI says he's innocent and will fight the new case. The charges come the same day a judge found DOJ unlawfully fired Comey's daughter, Maureen.
The administration never gave any performance-related explanation for firing her from her job as a federal prosecutor in New York. Carrie Johnson, NPR News.
Wall Street futures are on the downside this morning. This is NPR News from Washington.
Police in Tallahassee say a 15-year-old is under arrest in connection with a weekend shooting that left almost a dozen people injured near Florida A&M University's football stadium.
They say the teenager is facing charges that include attempted second-degree murder and possession of a firearm. Police say the gunfire erupted after a fight broke out following the school's homecoming football game. The youngest person injured is 11 years old.
The Milwaukee Brewers are a win away from capturing the team's first World Series title. Last night in Florida, the Brewers beat the Tampa Bay Rays 10-1 to take a three-games-to-none lead in Major League Baseball's Fall Classic.
As Steve Futterman reports, Milwaukee pulled away from the Rays midway through the game.
Milwaukee fan Dan Nederkorn, though, says there's no way the Brewers can now lose.
No team has ever won the World Series after losing the first three games. For NPR News, I'm Steve Futterman at the World Series in St. Petersburg, Florida.
Game four is tonight. I'm Dave Mattingly, NPR News in Washington.

Polymarket says it is investigating dozens of users for election insider trading
Former FBI director Comey says he is innocent of new charges
Judge rules DOJ unlawfully fired Comey's daughter Maureen, a federal prosecutor
Fifteen-year-old arrested after weekend shooting near Florida A&M football stadium
Milwaukee Brewers take 3-0 World Series lead over Tampa Bay Rays with 10-1 win
